items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Claude Hopkins only in the context of other people ('He used to be with Claude Hopkins', 'a fellow I used to work with who used to be in Claude Hopkins' band'). There is no direct statement of the interviewee working with, meeting, or being influenced by Claude Hopkins.

ctx.x: But he was also a trumpet player, wasn't he?
He was a trumpet player. He used to be with Claude Hopkins. He used to be with a lot of bands. And he was my buddy. He was a great manager, he really was. I was amazed at him, you being a manager.
